column4: server/errclass/errclass_test.go: TestClassTablesAgree (the REST and gRPC rendering tables are two renderings of one closed class set; no class renders as a success), TestOf_EverySentinelClassifiesWrapped, TestOf_TextIsNotAClass (an error that merely says not found / permission denied / already exists is Internal), TestOf_Priority (a storage read fault wrapped in a not-found text stays a retry answer; a refusal that names a missing target stays a refusal: no existence oracle), TestOfMutation; the adapters are tested in server/http/handlers (core_error_answer_test.go) and server/grpc/services (core_error_status_test.go) over every table row. Pure classification: no storage, no network, no authorization decision (every class is a refusal). Not adversarially reviewed yet.
